import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
img=np.array(Image.open('demo_rgb.png').convert('RGB'));H,W=img.shape[:2]
d=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int);cnt2=np.zeros((H,W),int);vis=img.copy();vis0=img.copy()
rect=0
for (_,r),(_,r0) in zip(d.iterrows(),o.iterrows()):
  xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(',')));ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
  if len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4: rect+=1
  m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)))],1);cnt+=m
  pi=Image.new('L',(W,H));ImageDraw.Draw(pi).polygon(list(zip(xs,ys)),fill=1,outline=1);cnt2+=np.array(pi)
  n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m);assert n==2,(n)
  assert (r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)==(min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))
  cv2.polylines(vis,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)))],True,(0,255,0),1)
  x0=list(map(int,r0.coords_x.split(',')));y0=list(map(int,r0.coords_y.split(',')))
  cv2.polylines(vis0,[np.array(list(zip(x0,y0)))],True,(255,0,0),1)
print('overlap cv2',(cnt>1).sum(),'overlap PIL',(cnt2>1).sum(),'rects',rect, 'cols same', list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), len(d)==len(o))
big=cv2.resize(np.hstack([vis0,vis]),None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
Image.fromarray(big).save('/tmp/vis.png')
"
